stages.title: Ratio language
stages.body: Convert comparisons into common units and scalable parts.

stages.title: Percent foundation
stages.body: Percent means per hundred; identify the base before operating.

stages.title: Successive change
stages.body: Multiply factors; do not add percentages blindly.

stages.title: Average
stages.body: Use total divided by count and preserve group weights.

stages.title: Profit, loss and discount
stages.body: Keep CP, SP and MP bases distinct.

stages.title: Interest
stages.body: Derive SI from principal-rate-time and CI from repeated growth.

stages.title: Mixtures
stages.body: Use conservation of quantity or alligation with validity checks.

stages.title: Partnership
stages.body: Profit share follows capital multiplied by time.

stages.title: Estimation and options
stages.body: Use smart numbers only when ratios remain invariant.

stages.title: Verification
stages.body: Reverse the change, recompute totals and inspect the percentage base.
